name: plan-verify-stale-refusal-double-walk
body: The plan-verify stale refusal does a second `git_state` walk after `is_stale`, and its new differing-input message is not pinned by a test (the phase-3 e2e covers `refusal_message` and `staleness_line`, not `plan_verify_at`); behaviour (refuse iff not fresh, N/A preserved) is unchanged. Upgrade if verify's refusal latency matters or the message wording must be pinned.
